title: Party 01
name: party-01
arc:
A party groove built on a side-to-side weight shift. From weight over the character-left foot the figure centres, rocks onto the character-right foot and briefly lifts the character-left foot at frame 4, then centres and returns to the character-left side, with the character-left arm lifting to chest height by frame 9.

Arms stay loose and low, swinging out with the hips. Pingpong: frames 0 and 22 are both planted turnarounds.

frames.cue: Weight over the character-left foot, both feet down. character-left knee slightly bent, character-right knee slightly bent. on the balls of both feet, heels lifted. character-left arm low by the hip, elbow slightly bent, by the side. character-right arm raised above shoulder, elbow slightly bent, across the body in front of the torso. torso leans character-right. character-left hip raised. character-left shoulder raised. hips turned character-left against the shoulders. head forward.
